claim.claim-text: 1. A system (100) for monitoring one or more characteristics in an animal population (150), comprising:

a concentrator (104) communicatively couplable to a plurality of animal tag assemblies (102), each of the animal tag assemblies (102) configured for being disposed on an animal of the animal population (150), each of the animal tag assemblies (102) including one or more sensors (114) configured to measure one or more animal characteristics of the animal of the animal population (150), wherein the concentrator (104) is configured to acquire the one or more animal characteristics from the plurality of animal tag assemblies (102); and, a remote server (108) communicatively coupled to the concentrator (104), wherein the remote server (108) includes one or more processors (130) configured to execute a set of program instructions stored in memory and configured to cause the remote server (108) to:

2. The system (100) of claim 1, wherein the assign one or more health states to one or more animals of the animal population (150) is also based on a multi-variable correction between at least two of the two or more animal characteristics derived from at least the data received from the plurality of animal tag assemblies (102).
3. The system (100) of claim 1, wherein the assign one or more health states to one or more animals of the animal population (150) also comprises:

4. The system (100) of claim 1, wherein the plurality of animal tag assemblies (102) include a first animal tag assembly and at least a second animal tag assembly, wherein the first animal tag assembly is configured for being disposed on a first animal of the animal population (150) and the at least a second animal tag assembly is configured for being disposed on at least a second animal of the animal population (150).

5. The system (100) of claim 4, wherein the first animal tag assembly includes one or more sensors (114) configured to measure one or more animal characteristics of the first animal of the animal population (150) and at least a second animal tag assembly includes one or more sensors (114) configured to measure one or more animal characteristics of the at least a second animal of the animal population (150).
6. The system (100) of claim 1, wherein the remote server (108) is further configured to receive local weather data for a location associated with the concentrator (104).
7. The system (100) of claim 1, wherein one or more animal tag assemblies of the plurality of the animal tag assemblies (102) comprise: one or more animal ear tag assemblies.
8. The system (100) of claim 1, wherein the assign one or more health states to one or more animals of the animal population (150) also comprises:

comparing the received data indicative of one or more animal characteristics of one or more animals of the animal population (150) to a set of standardized characteristics associated with the two or more animal characteristics to determine the existence of one or more abnormalities; and, wherein the assign one or more health states to one or more animals of the animal population (150) is also based on at least one of the one or more abnormalities.

9. The system (100) of claim 1, wherein the animal population (150) comprises: at least one of a population of livestock, a population of horses, a population of pet animals, a population of zoo animals, a population of wild animals, or a population of humans.
10. The system (100) of claim 1, wherein the one or more user devices (110) comprise: at least one of a laptop, a smartphone, a tablet, or a wearable device.

11. The system (100) of claim 1, wherein the particular animal tag assembly is configured to transmit a provisioning packet to the concentrator (104) in a provisioning time slot and wherein the concentrator (104) is configured to transmit an allotted data timeslot to the particular tag in response to receiving the provisioning packet, wherein the particular tag is configured to transmit one or more signals indicative of the one or more animal characteristics to the concentrator (104) at a time corresponding to the allotted data timeslot received from the concentrator (104).

12. The system (100) of claim 2, wherein the data from the plurality of animal tag assemblies (102) comprises raw data, wherein assign one or more health states to one or more animals of the animal population based on a multi-variable correlation between at least two of the two or more animal characteristics derived from at least the data received from the plurality of animal tag assemblies (102) comprises: assign one or more health states to one or more animals of the animal population (150) based on a multi-variable correlation between at least two of the two or more animal characteristics derived from at least the raw data received from the plurality of animal tag assemblies (102).

13. The system (100) of claim 2, wherein the data from the plurality of animal tag assemblies (102) comprises raw data, wherein assign one or more health states to one or more animals of the animal population (150) based on a multi-variable correlation between at least two of the two or more animal characteristics derived from at least the data received from the plurality of animal tag assemblies (102) comprises:

pre-processing the raw data into a format suitable for machine learning; and assign one or more health states to one or more animals of the animal population (150) based on a multi-variable correlation between at least two of the two or more animal characteristics derived from at least the pre-processed data.

14. The system (100) of claim 13, further comprising: filtering the pre-processed data based on at least one of a selected animal of the animal population (150), a selected group of animals of the animal population (150), or a selected time period prior to assigning one or more health states to one or more animals of the animal population (150) based on the multi-variable correlation between at least two of the two or more animal characteristics derived from at least the pre-processed data.
